description: Curated paths that can change AI Agent CPT behavior. Keep this list reviewable, add positive and negative classifier tests with every update, and do not treat it as a complete transitive dependency graph.
tradeoffs: For v1, shared parent POMs are conservative whole-file matches, and whole-module directory matches include docs and other nonbehavioral files. This can over-select, but avoids brittle content parsing while separate unrelated modules remain excluded; exact-head label authorization still prevents automatic paid-provider spend.
maintenance: Update this map when a mapped module adds or removes a first-party compile, runtime, or test dependency relevant to CPT; when registry or workflow inputs change; or when Maven parent, wrapper, or build configuration changes.
exclusions: Unrelated connectors co-packaged in the default bundle remain excluded: ordinary build and E2E coverage owns bundle-startup regressions, while including every packaged connector would fan one unrelated change out to all paid provider rows.

groups.name: direct AI Agent CPT inputs
groups.description: The connector, its real-provider tests, registry helpers, workflow, and pinned template CLI version directly define CPT behavior.

groups.name: Maven parents and dependency management
groups.description: These parent POMs control inherited dependency, plugin, and reactor configuration used to compile or execute the CPT modules.

groups.name: shared runtime, SDK, document, and provider support
groups.description: AI Agent execution and HTTP-backed tool/provider calls use these shared APIs, serializers, validators, clients, and runtime implementations.

groups.name: shared element-template tooling
groups.description: The AI Agent templates are generated from these shared annotations, generator logic, and Maven plugin.

groups.name: CPT application and test infrastructure
groups.description: The bundle-backed row and test harness build and execute through these application, image, fixture, and test-support modules, including inherited shared runtime test infrastructure.

groups.name: Maven execution infrastructure
groups.description: The checked-in Maven launcher and wrapper/build configuration determine how every CPT reactor build resolves and executes.
